modern-inventory.caption: The optional modern Tab inventory, with mouse-friendly equipment and item panels. Development capture; debug counters are not a performance benchmark.

fullscreen-map.alt: Full-screen map showing Surdana and objectives
fullscreen-map.caption: The M map keeps objectives and marked locations beside the full-screen map. Windows development capture.

inventory-strip.alt: Inventory strip over gameplay with a bow selected
inventory-strip.caption: The I inventory strip keeps equipment close at hand without opening the full Tab screen. Windows development capture.

pc-settings.alt: PC Settings categories in the native Linux player
pc-settings.caption: PC Settings in the native Linux player: display, audio, controls, gameplay and key bindings.

display-settings.alt: Display settings in the native Linux player
display-settings.caption: The portable Display settings screen. Unavailable renderer options are disabled on this target.

save-browser.alt: Modern save browser with a Surdana save preview
save-browser.caption: The modern save browser with a manual save and preview, captured on Linux.

linux-gameplay.alt: Rynn in Surdana in the native Linux player
linux-gameplay.caption: Native Linux gameplay in Surdana, using the software renderer.

browser-gameplay.alt: Rynn in Surdana in the browser player
browser-gameplay.caption: The browser build running from local files. Browser and native saves use separate storage.

narration-subtitles.alt: Intro narration with the added subtitle overlay

bow-aiming.alt: Rynn aiming with the modern bow crosshair
bow-aiming.caption: Modern bow aiming uses a center-screen crosshair. This sampled development capture illustrates the control mode, not game performance.
